name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: tools/lint/package-lock.json
      - run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: tools/lint
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: ruff format --check .
      - run: python -m pytest
      - run: python -m code_engine.lint_check --all
      - run: python -m code_engine.quality_checks --check-vaults
  studio:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: practice-studio
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: practice-studio/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run build
  lab:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: labs/LAB-PRG-T03-C01-01
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: tools/lint/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: tools/lint
      - run: npm run check:reference
